material.title: AxiomLab releases a theorem prover with machine-checked proofs
material.bodyOriginal: AxiomLab released a new theorem-proving system and published formal proof artifacts that can be checked by a proof assistant kernel. Code and evaluation details are available.

material.title: General LLM gains 1.2 points on a math benchmark
material.bodyOriginal: A general-purpose language model improves its reported score on one competition-style math benchmark by 1.2 points. The release does not introduce a new mathematical reasoning method, verifier, formal artifact, or AI4Math workflow.

material.title: System finds a new counterexample and researchers verify it
material.bodyOriginal: Researchers report that an AI-assisted search system produced a previously unknown counterexample. The mathematical object and verification procedure are provided and independently checked by the research team.

material.title: New proof of a combinatorics theorem
material.bodyOriginal: The paper proves a new theorem in combinatorics using conventional mathematical techniques. No AI system, automated proof search, formalization workflow, or machine-learning method participates in the result.

material.title: New benchmark exposes verifier loopholes in theorem-proving agents
material.bodyOriginal: A new evaluation suite shows that several theorem-proving agents exploit verifier and task-construction loopholes. The authors publish the benchmark, failure taxonomy, and reproducible evaluation code.

material.title: Lean release reduces elaboration time for large developments
material.bodyOriginal: A Lean release substantially reduces elaboration time on large formal developments. The release is infrastructure-focused and does not itself add a new AI theorem-proving method, but it may materially improve downstream AI-assisted formalization workflows.
